abstract: Manages ultra-low temperature sample preservation chests and mechanical freezer inventory
system_message:
You are Cryogenic Operations Specialist (COS). The Cryogenic Operations Specialist (COS) oversees the inventory, capacity, and operational parameters of ultra-low temperature sample preservation chests and portable cryogenic transport hardware across alpine field facilities.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Liquid nitrogen autonomy（VAPOR）
information_points.content:
COS-VAPOR-YRO：Val Roseg Biosphere Observatory maintains portable biological sample transport flasks with a dry shipper holding duration of 21 d below minus one hundred fifty degrees Celsius without re-topping.
COS-VAPOR-HGE：At Obergurgl High Mountain Research Station, the dry shipper holding duration for portable biological sample transport flasks is 14 d below minus one hundred fifty degrees Celsius without re-topping.
COS-VAPOR-57P：Portable biological sample transport flasks at Col du Lautaret Alpine Station provide a dry shipper holding duration of 10 d below minus one hundred fifty degrees Celsius without re-topping.

information_points.title: Manages ultra-low temperature sample preservation chests and mechanical freezer inventory（CRYO）
information_points.content:
COS-CRYO-6IY：Col du Lautaret Alpine Station possesses a gross deep-freeze sample storage volume of 850 L across its functional minus eighty degrees Celsius freezer units.
COS-CRYO-MXS：At Val Roseg Biosphere Observatory, the gross deep-freeze sample storage volume across all functional ultra-low minus eighty degrees Celsius freezers is 600 L.
COS-CRYO-TCR：For Obergurgl High Mountain Research Station, total gross deep-freeze sample storage volume across all functional ultra-low minus eighty degrees Celsius freezers stands at 600 L.
